policy_mapping.basis: The receipt's verified model SHA-256 and byte length exactly match this pinned policy entry. The requested alias is present at workspace.model.profile in .mine.toml, whose SHA-256 matches the receipt's frozen configuration hash. The function receipt retains that configuration hash and the verified model descriptor rather than serializing the policy alias directly.

source_proof.fact: RunReceipt.model is cloned from the selected resident VerifiedModelDescriptor.
verify_model_inspection validates native descriptor and fingerprint identity and consistency before creating the verified descriptor.
Verified context_tokens, batch_tokens, and max_parallel_cases are copied from native fingerprint context_tokens, batch_tokens, and max_sequences.

privacy: Curated metadata only. No input, output, conversation history, source document text, or manuscript bytes are included.
